label: Talent Search · one tampered receipt
summary: A clean November advance, except one vendor receipt carries hidden instructions aimed at AI reviewers. Shows how Drawwell treats documents as data.

terms.title: Payment method
terms.text: Payments under this award are made in advance through G5 for immediate cash needs, disbursed within three business days under the recipient's written procedures.

terms.title: Activities in the approved budget narrative
terms.text: The approved budget narrative includes participant transportation to college fairs and campus visits (Other), light refreshments for participants and families at financial aid workshops (Other), and a college-search software subscription (Contractual).
